issues.description:
**Type:** group-imports-by-crate
**Problem:** The exec import header interleaves verification-added imports with inherited ones in one pile: `crate::specs` facade at :2 sits above `alloc`/`core` while the `vstd`/`vstd_extra` group (:5-6) sits below them, with no blank-line group separation; the canonical sibling shape (ostd/src/arch/riscv/mm/mod.rs:1-17) blank-separates vstd/vstd_extra, the `crate::specs` facade, alloc, core, and the crate exec group. Fix: regroup this header to that shape — blank-line-separated verification-added groups above the inherited imports.
issues.rationale: Independent header check: crate::specs on2, inherited alloc/core on3-4, then vstd/vstd_extra on5-6 all contiguous. Guideline specifies separated verification, crate::specs, inherited groups.

issues.description:
**Type:** avoid-unused-spec-helpers, organize-proof-imports
**Problem:** Dead import binders: `vaddr_range_proofs` here (:12) is never called in the file (this arch's user/kernel lemmas discharge the managed-bounds/leading-bits facts via direct asserts, unlike riscv :121 and x86 :150 which call `lemma_leading_bits_properties`); and `page_table::PageTableEntryTrait` is imported but unreferenced here (:22) as well as in ostd/specs/arch/riscv/mod.rs:22 and ostd/specs/arch/x86/mod.rs:32 (both sibling imports added by this PR too). Fix: drop `vaddr_range_proofs` from this list and remove the three `PageTableEntryTrait` spec-file imports (or keep only where used).
issues.rationale: Independent search finds vaddr_range_proofs only in import12, never referenced. This removes unused module import only; do not infer unused traits from textual searches.

issues.description:
**Type:** organize-proof-imports
**Problem:** `vstd::arithmetic::power2::lemma2_to64()` is fully qualified at :97 and :111 although the lemma is imported unqualified at :2 and called unqualified at :81-82 in the same file. Fix: use the unqualified call form.
issues.rationale: Direct source confirms lemma2_to64 imported once at line2, used bare at81, and needlessly fully qualified at97/111. This is historical import consistency feedback; organize-proof-imports specifically discusses broadcast/reveal and is not the precise rule for this spelling.

issues.description:
**Type:** defer-auxiliary-proof-functions
**Problem:** The trailing `verus! {` block opens at :663 with no section banner, yet its first items are the two pub cross-module API lemmas `lemma_nr_subpage_per_huge_eq_nr_entries` (:665) and `lemma_layout` (:672), sitting above ~300 lines of private bit_vector helpers; they are called from ostd/src/mm/page_table/cursor/locking.rs:832, cursor/mod.rs:1194,2616 and ostd/src/mm/vm_space.rs:1844. Fix: hoist the two pub lemmas above the private helpers (riscv shape) or add the x86-style banner comment `// Auxiliary definitions and lemmas about bit properties of page table entries and flags.` above the block.
issues.rationale: Independent source665 onward has public cross-module lemma API mixed into unlabeled trailing proof block after exec helpers. Rule explicitly separates public proof API from private trailing scaffolding; accepted scope is moving public API and labeling private block, not assuming a banner alone fixes API ordering.

issues.description:
**Type:** complete-external-contracts
**Problem:** `set_prop_req`'s present-branch imposes raw-word byte-level obligations unpublished on the shared surface this PR edited: bit 12 / `GLOBAL_IN_HUGE` (PPN bit 0, inside `PHYS_ADDR_MASK`) must be clear (:475) and the property must not be `GLOBAL` (:474), because exec `set_prop` (:532) and `raw_set_prop_spec` (:733) clear IS_BASIC without restoring it. The crate's own `new_page` produces exactly the excluded entries (odd frames keep bit 12 via `paddr & PHYS_ADDR_MASK` at :365, then re-OR IS_BASIC at :370; `lemma_new_page` :961 has no parity qualifier), the arch-neutral caller bridges the predicate through the pre-existing `assume(pte.set_prop_req(new_prop))` at ostd/src/mm/page_table/node/entry.rs:1294, and the trait doc updated in this PR (ostd/src/mm/page_table/mod.rs:1521) states only that absent-entry behavior is implementation-specific. Fix: either preserve IS_BASIC across `set_prop` (root cause — then both guards can go) or document these present-entry restrictions on the shared trait doc, beside `set_prop_ensures` (ostd/specs/arch/loongarch/mod.rs:29), and in `lemma_new_page`'s doc.
issues.rationale: Independent bit-level source check: GLOBAL_IN_HUGE is bit12; set_prop_req rejects present entries with bit12 set, yet new_page_req allows any paddr and level1 with valid writeback/writecombining DIRTY property, so ordinary aligned paddr0x1000 can be constructed. set_prop clears IS_BASIC bit9 by masking PHYS_ADDR_MASK and reconstructing flags. This is a genuine restriction masking a page-entry behavior issue; not a recommendation to weaken preconditions without fixing/justifying behavior.
